name: query-ownership-modes
title: Query ownership: explicit-borrow modes and header channel
description: Resolve the retry.* query-namespace collision risk: query defaults to pure pass-through (target ownership), with the retry control plane borrowed explicitly via a path scheme-segment mode variant (URL channel, v0.1.0-compatible) or X-Reproxy-* headers (programmatic channel). Pure pass-through makes collision impossible rather than improbable; no new query reserved words (__retry__ rejected).
